note: UI Patterns Settings adds typed 'settings' to ui_patterns components (requires ui_patterns + token). Each setting type is a UiPatternsSettingType plugin (Plugin/UiPatterns/SettingType/, manager plugin.manager.ui_patterns_settings): built-ins include textfield, select, radios, checkboxes, boolean, number, token, url, links, attributes, machine_name, media_library, colorwidget, coloriswidget, enumeration, value, group, publish. A second plugin type UiPatternsSettingDataProvider (ids menu, breadcrumb) feeds dynamic option lists. The module's only config object is ui_patterns_settings.settings with a 'mapping' key binding {entity--field: 'pattern_id::setting_id'} (written by ConfigManager::addMapping; a setting_id of 'variant' drives the pattern variant). No configure route. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real mapping config: introspection reads mapping entries; execution writes field->setting and field->variant bindings, verified against the live ui_patterns_settings.settings config. Baseline mapping is empty.

evals.prompt: In UI Patterns Settings, how do you add a new kind of configurable setting to UI Patterns components (what plugin type), and do you still need hook_preprocess to pass the value to the template?
evals.expected_output: Implement a UiPatternsSettingType plugin (in Plugin/UiPatterns/SettingType/, manager plugin.manager.ui_patterns_settings). It renders the form element and normalizes the value, so hook_preprocess is not needed - the setting value is passed straight to the Twig template.

evals.prompt: Name several built-in setting types provided by UI Patterns Settings that I can use as a setting's 'type' in a pattern definition.
evals.expected_output: Built-in setting type ids include textfield, select, radios, checkboxes, boolean, number, token, url, links, attributes, machine_name, media_library, colorwidget, coloriswidget, enumeration, value, group, and publish.

evals.prompt: In UI Patterns Settings, which config object stores the binding between an entity field and a pattern setting, and what is the key and value format?
evals.expected_output: The config object is ui_patterns_settings.settings, under the 'mapping' key. Each entry maps {entity_type}--{field_name} (the field id with dots replaced by --) to a string "{pattern_id}::{setting_id}", e.g. node--field_promo: 'card::title'. Managed by ConfigManager::addMapping().

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the UI Patterns Settings configuration and tell me which pattern setting the entity field key node--field_promo is bound to.
evals.expected_output: node--field_promo is mapped to card::title (in ui_patterns_settings.settings under mapping), i.e. the 'title' setting of the 'card' pattern.

evals.prompt: In this site's UI Patterns Settings mapping, one field is bound to a pattern's variant. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which entity field key is mapped to a '::variant' setting.
evals.expected_output: node--field_style is mapped to card::variant in ui_patterns_settings.settings mapping, so that field drives the card pattern's variant.

evals.prompt: Using UI Patterns Settings, configure the live site so that the entity field key node--field_promo is bound to the 'title' setting of the 'card' pattern.
evals.expected_output: Add mapping['node--field_promo'] = 'card::title' to the ui_patterns_settings.settings config (via ConfigManager::addMapping('node.field_promo', 'card::title') or the config API). \Drupal::config('ui_patterns_settings.settings')->get('mapping')['node--field_promo'] is then 'card::title'.

evals.prompt: Configure UI Patterns Settings on the live site so that the entity field key node--field_variant drives the 'card' pattern's variant (the '::variant' setting).
evals.expected_output: Add mapping['node--field_variant'] = 'card::variant' to ui_patterns_settings.settings. Because the setting_id is 'variant', ConfigManager::findVariantMappings() treats that field as the pattern variant source. \Drupal::config('ui_patterns_settings.settings')->get('mapping')['node--field_variant'] is then 'card::variant'.
